status: DRAFT, not registered. Under plan registration.amendment_rule it may be registered (saved as benchmarks/ball2011_track_plan_amendment_1.json with its sha256 record benchmarks/ball2011_track_plan_amendment_1.registration.json: amendment_sha256, plan_sha256, registered_utc) only after Stage 7 has run the plan's N = 200 smoke gate with the registered step numerics and preserved the failing runs under benchmarks/results/<date>-ball-track/. The smoke gate starts from the row-0 model of 'relax --run C1' with Amendments 3, 4 and 2 (the registered seed admits no row-0 model, the registered photosphere solve blocks the amended seed and the registered relaxation is not seed-unique); it is run first without and then with --fallback F1 (plan stop_rules: fallbacks in order), and both runs are preserved. Fill in preserved_failing_run and smoke_gate_result from those runs (smoke.json, including rejection_causes), set status to 'registered', and change nothing else without new evidence. If the registered smoke gate passes instead, this amendment has no evidence and must not be registered.
kind: numerical-method bug fix (plan registration.amendment_rule). Untouched: tolerances, primary physics, microphysics, targets, and every immutable section (model, replication_mode, comparison, endpoint, qualitative_checks, conservation, restart, convergence_campaign.thresholds, verdict_rules).
settings_note: Machine-readable form of 'changes', applied by scripts/validate_ball_track.py --amendment after it verifies this file against benchmarks/ball2011_track_plan_amendment_1.registration.json (amendment_sha256, plan_sha256). The driver refuses an amendment whose status starts with 'DRAFT', whose preserved_failing_run does not name a run directory under benchmarks/results/<date>-ball-track/ whose smoke.json, relax.json or termination.json records a failure, or whose settings leave the amendable numerical-method keys (quasistatic.base, quasistatic.base_mass_fraction, stepcontrol.metric; relaxation.mesh_cycles, mesh_tolerance and cycle_dt_years belong to Amendment 2, replication.seed_surface and seed_radii_rsun to Amendment 3, quasistatic.photosphere_bracket to Amendment 4). changes.registered: Lagrangian |dln T| per cell and |dln r| per face, excluding gas within 2 x (that step's swept mass) of the base
changes.amended: |dln T| per cell and |dln r| per face measured against the step predictor, i.e. at fixed mass above the base in the inner half of the envelope and at fixed mass below the surface in the outer half (stepcontrol metric 'mapped')
changes.defect: The excluded band (2 x swept) lies inside the base cell whenever the swept mass is below half of it. Face 1 then moves inward by about (swept/3 dm0)(1 - (r0/r1)^3) in Lagrangian terms, which is gas flowing through a quasi-steady base, not a change of the structure. The controller therefore holds swept/dm0 near 0.015 and dt near delta_target dm0/Mdot, and never reaches the regime (swept >> dm0) where the exclusion works. In the base's quasi-steady frame (fixed mass above the base) the same step changes the structure by 1e-4 to 5e-3.

changes.registered: Lagrangian interior. The base is sliced and re-split every step (hysteresis split 2.0 / merge 0.5).
changes.amended: Fixed-mass base region (fallback F2, quasistatic base = 'fixed_mass', base_mass_fraction = 0.05). After the slice, every cell below the first Lagrangian face at or above 5% of the envelope mass is remapped conservatively (overlap shares; volume and total energy conserved, T by EOS inversion, defect booked to remap_energy_defect, re-faced potential reported as potential_reallocation per Amendment A1 of the spec) onto faces at integer levels N = 1..m of the STARS-Q target count of the accepted state, N(mu) = integral of dmu/t(mu) in mass above the base, with N(top) - m in [0.5, 1.5). Gas drains through these cells (donor-cell advection). Faces above the region stay Lagrangian and bitwise; split/merge never acts on the region.
changes.defect: As a base cell drains, a neighbour crosses a split or merge threshold. The discrete structure near the coarse base and its face-extrapolated boundary state (rho_b, T_b, r0) then jump by the change of their truncation error, whatever dt is, and every retry is rejected until the 12-retry termination trigger fires: a numerical_failure that is not a property of the model. The draining base cell also moves rho_b continuously by about 0.2 x (swept/dm0) per step, which pins dt even with the mapped metric. With fixed-mass base cells the base state is continuous in dt and quasi-steady.

not_amended.F1: Fallback F1 (pseudo-transient continuation inside a step) is in the registered plan and needs no amendment. It is implemented as quasistatic.ptc (off by default; Kelley-Keyes switched evolution relaxation with pseudo-time on the first-law and black-hole growth rows, entered only when the damped Newton solve of an evolve or landing step fails, handing over to the plain Newton solve so that an accepted step meets the registered residual tolerance) and is switched on by the driver's --fallback F1. It cannot address this blocker. MESA dry run (N = 200, row 0 from Amendments 3 and 2, registered step numerics): the four attempts at dt = 1, 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125 yr all converge in Newton and are all rejected by the registered Lagrangian metric (delta_actual 0.094, 0.042, 0.037, 0.018 against 2 x 0.005, profile_dlnr); dt then falls below t_dyn = 0.0913 yr and the termination trigger fires with no accepted step. With --fallback F1 the run is identical, because F1 is entered only when a Newton solve fails. Analytic toy: at dt = 3 and 10 yr on the registered base (the slice takes 90% of the base cell, the piston, cavity and growth rows have no nearby discrete solution, residual stalls at 0.165 on the piston row) neither Newton nor F1 converges; with F2 the same and larger steps converge in 2-3 Newton iterations. An earlier trial with pseudo-time on every row (a full row-unknown pairing) diverged where Newton converges and reached a second, remote root; it was rejected (Reports/evidence/report23/ball/stage7_unblock_approaches.json). Applying F1 in the registered order is therefore a formal step: it acts only on a failed Newton solve and cannot act on a controller-metric rejection, so the F1 smoke run is cited as the application of the fallback order, not as evidence that F1 was tried against a Newton failure. On MESA it has rescued no step that fails in Newton: four such steps (registered base at dt = 50 and 30 yr, fixed-mass base at 400 and 1000 yr) all end 'Pseudo-time step collapsed' (second review, Reports/evidence/report23/ball/review_evidence/DRYRUN_f1.log). A step it does rescue reports the failed Newton, pseudo-time and final Newton iterations together as its Newton iterations, so the controller's factor 0.8 for more than 8 iterations applies to it.
not_amended.F3: Not needed: the dt-unknown landing converged in every toy test.

tests_failed_before_pass_after: tests/test_quasistatic.py::test_registered_controller_pins_dt_and_amendment_releases_it (registered: the last 6 of 12 accepted dt <= 0.1 yr; amended: no rejection and dt >= 20 yr within 14 steps)

tests/test_quasistatic.py::test_registered_base_resplit_jump_is_dt_independent_and_reported (registered base: a forced base re-split moves rho_b by about -11% at dt = 1e-2 and 1e-3 yr; fixed-mass base: <= 1e-5)

toy_evidence.configuration: Analytic microphysics (ideal gas plus radiation, electron scattering), ML1 alpha = 2, Ball cavity (face state, b = 1) and photosphere, thesis eq 3.15 with eta = 0.1, 1e4 Msun, M_BH = 5 Msun, 3000 Rsun seed, 128 zones, relaxed; delta_target 0.005. Not the registered Ball configuration (MESA, N = 200/400).
toy_evidence.registered_metric_and_base: dt 1 yr rejected down to about 0.06 yr; then profile_dlnr = 0.00455 on 58 consecutive steps with dt falling from 0.044 to 0.026 yr; at step 59 a re-split of cell 1 (dm/target 2.01) moved rho_b by -8.6% to -8.8% at every dt from 0.026 to 6.3e-6 yr; 13 consecutive rejections fired the termination trigger.
toy_evidence.mapped_metric_lagrangian_base: dt 0.04 to 0.15 yr, limited by dln rho_b from the draining base cell; the same re-split at step 24 then gave 13 rejections and termination.
toy_evidence.fixed_mass_base_lagrangian_metric: dt pinned at 0.053 yr by profile_dlnr.
toy_evidence.amended: From dt = 1 yr (quasistatic.py implementation, model relaxed on the fixed-mass base): no rejection in 60 accepted steps; dt reaches 57.7 yr at step 10, then 38.5-57.7 yr (median 45.7 yr), limited by dln rho_b and dln r0 (about 0.45% per step, the evolution of the base); 1 predictor pass, 2-3 Newton iterations; per-step energy residual change <= 7.3e-16 of the initial internal energy, mass <= 2.4e-16, regrid EOS-inversion defect <= 4.1e-16 of the initial internal energy. base_mass_fraction 0.01 and 0.05 and target-count regions of 8 and 16 levels gave the same dt history; a 4-level region failed to relax (its top face flipped between steep base cells). The 100 Msun, M_BH = 1 face and cell toys run at about 2400 yr steps without rejections.
toy_evidence.relaxation_note: With the fixed-mass base the regrid reaches its fixed point geometrically (cell masses change by a factor about 0.72 less per step on the toy), so relaxation convergence must be judged on the cell-by-cell change between consecutive accepted states; the converged state is then well balanced to 1e-10 over a 1e6 yr step.

consequences_for_registered_runs: C7 (split/merge 1.5/0.67) then tests the thresholds of the Lagrangian part only; the base region is never split or merged.

Every accepted step reports base_region_cells, base_region_mass, regrid_energy_defect, regrid_entropy_change and regrid_potential_reallocation (over L_BH dt); steps with split/merge events report remesh_dln_base_density, remesh_dln_base_temperature and remesh_dln_inner_radius from a counterfactual solve on the pre-event mesh.
The Stage 5 driver must record numerics.controller.metric = 'mapped' and quasistatic.base = 'fixed_mass' in every run directory together with this amendment's sha256.

quasistatic.base and base_mass_fraction enter the row-0 signature: every row-0 model must be relaxed again with this amendment (relax --run ... with Amendments 3, 4, 2 and 1, the same --amendment flags in the same order on every later command).

Not registered runs; no comparison with the published tables. The first unblock round had the photosphere bracket scan unconditional (now Amendment 4's option).
mesa_dry_run_evidence.registered_step_numerics: Smoke gate from the row-0 model of Amendments 3 + 4 + 2, N = 200, without and with --fallback F1: termination_trigger at step 0 (dt 0.0625 yr < t_dyn 0.0913 yr) after 4 of 4 attempts rejected by profile_dlnr (delta_actual 0.094, 0.042, 0.037, 0.018 against 2 x 0.005); no accepted step; smoke.json passed false; rejection_causes: 4 controller_metric (profile_dlnr). Identical with and without F1.
mesa_dry_run_evidence.amended: Row 0 relaxed again with Amendments 3 + 4 + 2 + 1 (N = 200: 215 and 220 accepted steps, 7 mesh cycles, seeds agree to 5.5e-11; N = 400: 82 and 82 steps, 5 cycles, 6.0e-11). Smoke-like probes stopped after 300 accepted steps: no rejection, 1 predictor pass, median 3 Newton iterations, median dt 56.5 yr (N = 200) and 56.3 yr (N = 400), limited by |dln rho_b| on 289 of 300 steps; M_BH 5 -> 8.57 Msun at both resolutions. The probes stop far short of M_BH = 100, so they do not show whether the gate's median dt >= 50 yr criterion is met.
